chunks.text: Dosage form(s): Acceptable dosage forms when used according to the requirements indicated in this monograph: Collodion-like solution; Karaya gum, glycol plaster; Plaster (US FDA 2021)

Use(s) or Purpose(s): Wart remover (US FDA 2021).
(Product) for the removal of common warts (US FDA 2021).
(Product) for the removal of plantar warts on the bottom of the foot (US FDA 2021).
Common and/or plantar wart treatment (US FDA 1990).
Subpopulation(s): Children 2-11 years; Adolescents 12-17 years; Adults 18 years and older

Quantity(ies): Table 3. Doses of Salicylic acid associated with dosage forms
Dosage forms
Doses
Collodion-like solution
5 - 17%
Karaya gum, glycol plaster
15%
Other types of plasters
12 - 40%
Reference: US FDA 2021.
Complementary Ingredient (Safety only)
Not to exceed 30% of lactic acid (Fiume 1998).

Direction(s) for use: Products formulated in a collodion-like solution (US FDA 2021)
Wash affected area and dry thoroughly.
Apply one drop/small amount at a time with applicator/brush to sufficiently cover each wart. Let dry.
Do not apply to surrounding skin.
Repeat this procedure once or twice daily as needed (until wart is removed) for up to 12 weeks.
Products formulated in a karaya gum, glycol plaster (US FDA 2021)
Wash affected area and dry thoroughly.
Gently smooth wart surface with emery file supplied.
Apply a drop of warm water to the wart, keeping the surrounding skin dry.
Apply (medicated) plaster at bedtime and leave in place for at least 8 hours.
Remove and discard plaster in morning.
Repeat this procedure every 24 hours as needed (until wart is removed) for up to 12 weeks.
Products formulated with other types of plaster (US FDA 2021)
Wash affected area and dry thoroughly.
Apply (medicated) plaster.
Repeat this procedure every 48 hours as needed (until wart is removed) for up to 12 weeks.
All products (Optional)
May soak wart in warm water for 5 minutes. 1
1 Note: To be listed at the beginning of the procedure, after washing the affected area.
Karaya gum, glycol plaster and other plasters (if applicable)
Cut plaster to fit wart.

Caution(s) and warning(s): All products
For external use only (US FDA 2021).
Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician/podiatrist if discomfort persists (US FDA 2021).
Products formulated in a collodion-like solution
Extremely flammable/flammable/combustible (US FDA 2021).
Keep away from fire or flame (US FDA 2021).
Cap bottle tightly and store at room temperature away from heat (US FDA 2021).
When using this product avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water for 15 minutes (US FDA 2021).
When using this product avoid inhaling vapours (US FDA 2021).

Contraindication(s): All products
Do not use on irritated, infected or reddened skin (US FDA 2021).
Do not use if you have diabetes or poor blood circulation (US FDA 2021).
Do not use on moles, birthmarks, mucous membranes, warts with hair growing from them, genital warts, or warts on the face (US FDA 2021).
